projects.text: Several projects. Several agents. One window.

new.text: Each session gets its own worktree.

work.text: Agents keep working while you look away.

path.text: Click a path the agent printed.

diff.text: See what changed. Edit it in place.

pr.text: One press hands the review to an agent.

reviews.text: Who is waiting on you, longest first.

theme.text: Three themes, or your own colours.

revive.text: Kill the daemon. Every session comes back.
